scope: Pinned upstream component assertions with explicit setup/API adaptations. No partitionline73/runtime or multi-node durable-history qualification.
adaptations: Place probe in org.apache.kafka.raft to access the protected LeaderState constructor without reflection; replace upstream Mockito accumulator setup with real BatchAccumulator, Metrics and MemoryPool.NONE.
Use fixed directory IDs/voters and1/3/5-voter histories; five-voter and over-end precondition boundary cases are derived component extensions, not a verbatim upstream test suite.
Use explicit base offset, current partition epoch and timestamp1000 for real metadata-log batches, matching the upstream append helper requirements.

For4.1.2/4.2.1 use official Scala KafkaMetadataLog.apply/read(offset,isolation) and classic record package;4.3.1 uses renamed Java KafkaRaftLog.createLog/read(offset,isolation,bytes) and internal record package. Exact textual adaptations/counts and compiled sources are retained.
Deliberate failing variant changes only the current-epoch barrier expectation(-1 to10), leaves libraries/input history unchanged, and must exit nonzero with the named AssertionError.
component_boundary: Bare Apache LeaderState accepts unvalidated over-local-end replica positions; actual probe documents this component precondition boundary. It does not establish KafkaRaftClient accepts malformed network ACKs; partitionline typed routing requires independent request/member/term/sequence/prefix validation.
durability_boundary: Real local truncation+fsync/reopen preserves exact committed byte prefix, while reopened Apache local component high-watermark resets0; durable replicated commit is a separate73 WAL/causal-history responsibility.
